svg.title: Period 2 — Filling 2s and 2p One Electron at a Time
svg.desc: The eight elements of period 2 (Li through Ne) shown in order. Each element has a card with its symbol, atomic number, full electron configuration, and a row of orbital boxes (1s, 2s, 2p_x, 2p_y, 2p_z) with up/down arrows showing the spin. Hund's rule is visible across B, C, N (parallel spins) and pairing begins at O.
svg.text: Period 2 — Building the Second Shell, Element by Element
Eight elements, eight electrons added in Aufbau order. Hund's rule: parallel spins fill 2p before pairing.
